entries.title: I Chronicles 17:1
segments: ¶Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD [remaineth] under curtains.

words.text: ¶Now it came to pass, as David

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:2
segments: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that [is] in thine heart; for God [is] with thee.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:3
segments: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

words.text: And it came to pass the same night

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:4
segments: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:5
segments: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from [one] tabernacle [to another]. {have gone: Heb. have been}

words.text: For I have not dwelt in

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:6
segments: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:7
segments: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, [even] from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel: {from following: Heb. from after}

words.text: Now therefore thus shalt thou say

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:8
segments: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that [are] in the earth.

words.text: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:9
segments: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,

words.text: in their place, and shall be moved
no more; neither shall the children

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:10
segments: And since the time that I commanded judges [to be] over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:11
segments: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go [to be] with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

words.text: And it shall come to pass, when thy days
thee, which shall be of thy sons

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:12
segments: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:13
segments: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took [it] from [him] that was before thee:

words.text: , and he shall be my son

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:14
segments: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:15
segments: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

words.text: , and according to all this vision

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:16
segments: ¶And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who [am] I, O LORD God, and what [is] mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:17
segments: And [yet] this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast [also] spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.

words.text: And [yet] this was a small thing
for a great while to come

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:18
segments: What can David [speak] more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:19
segments: O LORD, for thy servant's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all [these] great things. {great...: Heb. greatnesses}

words.text: sake, and according to thine own heart

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:20
segments: O LORD, [there is] none like thee, neither [is there any] God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

words.text: , [there is] none like thee, neither [is there any] God
thee, according to all that we have heard

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:21
segments: And what one nation in the earth [is] like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem [to be] his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:22
segments: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, LORD, becamest their God.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:23
segments: Therefore now, LORD, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:24
segments: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts [is] the God of Israel, [even] a God to Israel: and [let] the house of David thy servant [be] established before thee.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:25
segments: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found [in his heart] to pray before thee. {hast...: Heb. hast revealed the ear of thy servant}

words.text: thee. {hast...: Heb. hast revealed the ear of thy servant}

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:26
segments: And now, LORD, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:27
segments: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD, and [it shall be] blessed for ever. {let...: or, it hath pleased thee}
